label: Web Designer
summary: Two Web Designing Resumes against DevOps and Apparel.
job_description:
KPMG Netherlands is hiring a Web Designer to design and build responsive pages and campaign sites within an established brand system.

What we need:
- Hbo degree in Web Design or related
- 2+ years web design/management experience
- Basic HTML/CSS knowledge
- Web design
- CMS management

The original posting also asked for the following, which this demo does not gate on: CMS experience (WordPress/Drupal); Fluent Dutch and English; Interest in AI applications; HTML/CSS; SEO; Accessibility; Analytics; UX; AI awareness.
